answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 26545 Country: Bangladesh Title: Will ablution be valid by using waterproof eye liner? Question: Assalamualikum ! will ablution be valid by using waterproof eye liner? Answer ID: 26545 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2526/1569/H=1431) Wudhu and ghusl will not be valid after using waterproof eyeliner until the element vanishes. Note: The answer is correct. However, if the eyeliner does not have any layer rather it leaves only colour like kajal (lamp-black), then. If the case is so, explain it and submit the question again. (D) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
